we introduce a new framework for hierarchical compositional learning of visual concepts that learns from a few symbol-image pairs without any supervision and is capable of multimodally traversing the learnt hierarchy of concepts.

we present SCAN, a new framework for unsupervised learning of compositional and hierarchical visual concepts, that learns concepts through fast symbolic associations and grounding in unsupervised disentangled visual features, that can generate a diverse set of images from symbolic descriptions and manipulate the learnt visual concepts with symbolic instructions.

SCAN can learn a large number of visual concepts through unsupervised symbol association, that these concepts can be recombined through learned logical operations, and that this recombination can be used to generate novel images.
